map.强轴弱轴是什么？: What are the strong and weak axes?
map.惯性矩较大的轴为强轴（抗弯强），较小的为弱轴；型钢应使强轴对应大弯矩方向。: The axis with the larger moment of inertia is the strong axis (bending-wise strong) and the smaller one the weak axis; for a rolled section the strong axis should face the direction of the larger bending moment.
map.平行轴定理何时用？: When is the parallel-axis theorem used?
